topography.project_purpose: Structural profile: 30 project-authored contract(s) across 1 chain(s); 11 ERC20 tokens, 1 ERC721 NFT, 2 Chainlink feeds; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 3 functional families. Its contracts share 1 common project-authored base contract(s) (delayedupgradeable). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
